lesson.title: Sell transit to the neighbour
lesson.goal: GerbangTenggara buys transit from PopMakassar and WargaTenggara reaches KontenSulawesi

step.text: The neighbouring province signed a transit contract. PopMakassar already runs BGP in system 64701, names 10.9.61.2 as its customer in system 64702, and announces the content network 10.9.200.0/24. The customer side is still blank.
On GerbangTenggara, open the console and start BGP: router bgp 64702.
Point it at the seller: neighbor 10.9.61.1 remote-as 64701. Both ends now name each other, so the session comes up.
A session alone moves nothing. The seller's announcement must land in your table: run show ip route and find 10.9.200.0/24 learned over BGP.
The seller must also learn the way back. Announce your own customers: network 10.60.1.0 mask 255.255.255.0. Then ping KontenSulawesi from WargaTenggara.

check.label: The transit session with PopMakassar is established
GerbangTenggara learned the content network over BGP
